dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, hello there. These are some abandoned machines that my daughter Alida picked up. She likes to do that, bringing back all kinds of odds and ends from her outdoor play sessions.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Some of them even move with a wee fix-em-up. Since the kids nearby are fond of 'em, I don't see the harm in giving them out. Alida's friends are especially big fans...
